state.seed_assertion: Tags that cannot have caused a fault, such as HMI setpoints and recipe numbers, should not be included in a trend because they waste memory and processing without adding diagnostic value.

sentences.1: A good maintenance log entry includes specific asset ID, date, work type, exact parts replaced, failure details, downtime duration, and technician name.
sentences.2: This information helps when similar problems occur later and provides training material for other engineers.
sentences.3: Did the motor stop suddenly or slow down gradually? Was there unusual noise? Did anything smell hot? These observable details point toward causes that logs and alarms cannot reveal.
sentences.4: If an ISO or IATF auditor asks when an entry was actually recorded versus backfilled from memory a week later, a spreadsheet has no way to answer that.
sentences.5: A controller major fault may leave a fault code and task information.
sentences.6: Real-time data streaming to dashboards enables decision-making based on current information rather than historical data.
sentences.7: Recording root cause for reactive work, even as a one-line guess, is better than nothing because patterns emerge from multiple guesses.
